title: Trigonometric Ratios: Sine, Cosine and Tangent
seo_title: Sec 2 Trigonometric ratios Worksheets: Free Secondary 2 Maths with Answers (MOE Syllabus)
standard_text: use of trigonometric ratios (sine, cosine and tangent) of acute angles to calculate unknown sides and angles in right-angled triangles
meta_desc: Free Secondary 2 trigonometry worksheets with diagrams: label opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse, choose sin, cos or tan, find missing sides and angles, exact values and elevation problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: SOH CAH TOA: sin = O/H, cos = A/H, tan = O/A.
key_sub: Label the sides from the angle first. To find an angle, use sin⁻¹, cos⁻¹ or tan⁻¹.
body_html:
How it works

Label the sides from the angle θ: opposite (across from θ), adjacent (next to θ) and hypotenuse (longest, opposite the right angle). Then use SOH CAH TOA:

  • sin θ = O ÷ H
  • cos θ = A ÷ H
  • tan θ = O ÷ A

To find an angle, use the inverse buttons sin−1, cos−1, tan−1.

Example

The hypotenuse is 10 cm and the angle is 30°. Find the opposite side.

SOH: O = 10 × sin 30°.

Answer: 5 cm

Example

Opposite = 7 cm, adjacent = 9 cm. Find the angle.

TOA: θ = tan−1(7 ÷ 9).

Answer: 37.9°

Example

The adjacent side is 8 cm and the angle is 40°. Find the hypotenuse.

CAH: cos 40° = 8 ÷ H.

H = 8 ÷ cos 40°.

Answer: 10.4 cm

Common mistakes

  • Labelling the sides from the right angle instead of from θ.
  • Choosing the wrong ratio. Write down which two sides you have first.
  • Multiplying when the unknown is on the bottom: if sin 40° = 10 ÷ x, then x = 10 ÷ sin 40°.
  • Using sin instead of sin−1 to find an angle, or having the calculator in radians.

faq.q: What does SOH CAH TOA mean?
faq.a: sin = opposite ÷ hypotenuse, cos = adjacent ÷ hypotenuse, tan = opposite ÷ adjacent.

faq.q: How do I choose which ratio to use?
faq.a: Write down the two sides involved (the one you know and the one you want). The pair tells you the ratio.

faq.q: How do I find a missing angle?
faq.a: Work out the ratio of the two sides, then use the inverse button, for example tan⁻¹(7 ÷ 9).

faq.q: What is the difference between Pythagoras and trigonometry?
faq.a: Pythagoras links three sides. Trigonometry links two sides and an angle.

items.q: In a right-angled triangle, the opposite side is 9 cm and the adjacent side is 14 cm. Which ratio finds an angle?
items.e: SOH: sin = O/H. CAH: cos = A/H. TOA: tan = O/A. With the opposite side and adjacent side, use tan (TOA).

items.q: Which side is the hypotenuse, relative to the angle θ?
items.e: The hypotenuse is the longest side, opposite the right angle: R.
